title: SpongeBob's Spell Flyer
description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene featuring a blue-skinned witch with green spiky hair casting a spell from a large glowing purple and orange swirling vortex in a massive gnarled tree. SpongeBob SquarePants rides a red wagon labeled 'SPELL FLYER' holding a glowing house, while a black dragon flies above and a green cat-like creature in a cracked orb with a monstrous face sits on a cliff. The scene includes cherry blossoms, koi fish, butterflies, and floating spell scrolls.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy painting of a blue-skinned witch with wild green hair and a flowing blue and pink dress casting magic from a large glowing purple orange swirling vortex embedded in a massive ancient gnarled tree with pink cherry blossoms. SpongeBob SquarePants happily rides a red wagon labeled SPELL FLYER holding a glowing white house, a black dragon with lightning flies in a stormy sky, a green cat creature with a spiked collar sits inside a cracked spherical orb featuring a monstrous face on a cliffside, with koi fish swimming in water below, floating spell scrolls, and butterflies throughout the scene.
